cohort: 241 patients in the women's health unit (WHU) of an Australian teaching hospital
finding: The study found a high frequency of MRPs (454 potential MRPs identified) in a women's health unit, with 8.6% deemed clinically significant, particularly among women admitted following a cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The highest number of MRPs (49%) was identified among women admitted following a cesarean delivery, with 83 of 85 women in this group experiencing at least 1 MRP.
